modes.label: Digit inside a rate
modes.description: A digit within a percentage that is about to end or continue with a decimal.

card.writes: It suppresses the word 'percent' and its variants, so the model writes the % sign instead.
card.plain: It marks a digit inside a percentage figure in a side-effect comparison, where the % sign follows rather than the word percent.
